new_episodes.source_paraphrase: After a 29 January carjacking report, police reviewed video of a woman returning the victim’s phone. On 1 February, Oliver submitted extracted images for facial-recognition searching.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: The investigative image and the offence account establish the task context. They do not independently identify the person to be arrested.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: The facial-recognition search produced 73 candidates and an investigator narrowed them to Woodruff as the investigative lead; the selection was peer reviewed.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Human narrowing and peer review of machine-generated candidates remain part of the originating inferential process and do not, by themselves, establish an independent identity basis for coercive action. Reliance on the nominated identity also requires assurance calibrated to the arrest workflow.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The facial-recognition nomination materially structured the identity pathway, but peer review and a separately prepared witness lineup supplied additional evidence before the warrant. Because the preserved record does not establish that the biometric inference itself became sufficient authority for arrest, the occurrence materially engages the inferential-evidence boundary without satisfying a failure-occurrence finding.

The facial-recognition nomination entered a reliance-bearing arrest pathway. Peer review and a witness lineup added assurance, but the record does not establish that the machine inference itself supplied coercive authority. The remaining assurance question is the independence and sufficiency of those checks.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: A separately prepared photo lineup included Woodruff, and the victim selected her while stating that the choice was based on seeing the suspect in person for multiple hours.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Downstream human evidence can supply independent assurance only to the extent that its method and evidentiary basis can genuinely falsify rather than merely reinforce the machine-generated nomination.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The separately prepared lineup and victim identification are material evidence independent of the machine score itself, limiting any claim that the biometric inference alone acquired coercive authority; the occurrence remains informative to the class boundary because the machine nomination determined whose identity entered the downstream verification pathway.

Peer review and a separately prepared photo lineup were performed, but their independence and sufficiency did not prevent mistaken identity from reaching arrest; this materially distinguishes inadequate verification from omission of verification.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: On 4 February, Oliver sought arrest warrants after the witness identification and criminal-history review. A police captain and prosecutor approved the request; a magistrate signed the warrant.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A nomination, witness identification and authorised warrant are distinct evidentiary and decision stages. Judicial approval does not establish biometric correctness.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: Woodruff was arrested on 16 February 2023 while eight months pregnant. After booking, Oliver recognised that the pregnancy and a tattoo contradicted the suspect identification. Woodruff remained in custody under the warrant.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Material contradictory identity evidence must remain capable of reopening and defeating an inferential identification before the inference produces a coercive effect.

taxonomy_relationships.rationale: The advanced-pregnancy contradiction is material to whether the overall identity pathway remained adequately defeasible, but it does not by itself establish that a probabilistic machine inference was promoted into independent authority for arrest.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: Oliver tried to obtain dismissal and told the arraignment magistrate they had the wrong person. Woodruff was released at about 19:00 on personal bond and received hospital treatment for contractions.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Recognition of a contradiction and a request to correct it are separate from effective release. The record of communication must not be replaced by an inference that no correction was attempted.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: The officer reported mistaken identity to the prosecutor the next morning. The phone was returned on 17 February. A different prosecutor lacked dismissal information at the 27 February conference; the charges were dismissed on 7 March.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: Delivery, transfer between decision-makers and final disposition require separate evidence. One later recipient’s lack of information does not prove that an earlier communication was never made.

new_episodes.source_paraphrase: The City was dismissed by stipulation in November 2024. On 5 August 2025, the federal court granted the remaining officer summary judgment. It declined to decide the broader facial-recognition taint theory because Woodruff did not adopt that argument.
new_episodes.recovered_invariant_interpretation: A judgment is bounded by the claims and arguments it decides. It does not settle an expressly undecided biometric-evidence theory.
